limitations: Development checks do not grant central Scientific Acceptance.
Graphix uses sampled measurement branches and the requested product input, not arbitrary-channel verification.
Symmer preserves the supplied symmetry sector; no global ground-state claim.
PauLie span and dimension are checked; classification labels are upstream descriptions.
Full-check log records the tested workspace at execution time; unrelated concurrent changes are excluded from the integration commit.
